label: Childhood events
summary: Rolls for a random childhood event for a child who is a ruler.
details: Script fires it, not the game's code. It only runs if the character is a ruler and an available child. There is a 50 percent chance that anything is rolled at all, and 'nothing happens' has weight 400 among the events. The events are about crushes, friends, bullies and victims, guardian parents, pets, studying with a friend, and a few story events that vanilla marks as BP1 and BP2.

label: Spouse task setup
summary: Picks one of the spouse council task on_actions for a character, or none.
details: Script fires it. It first rolls a chance to happen at all (a constant defined in script). For AI characters only, it then adds a chance of 'no event' that is higher for lower titles (30 for king or higher, 70 for duke, 95 for any other AI), to save performance. Otherwise it picks by weight: chivalry 100, and court politics, domain management, patronage and court intrigue 20 each.

label: Spouse chivalry task
summary: Rolls a random event from the martial tasks of the character's spouse councillor.
details: Script fires it; vanilla's chivalry_setup lists it. It only runs if the character has a spouse councillor and that spouse is the same character as the saved scope named councillor. 'Nothing' has weight 300. The events give things like more levies, army morale, prestige, dread, health boosts, cheaper mercenaries, a tourney, or stopping a war between vassals.

label: Christian pilgrim arrival
summary: Rolls an arrival event for a Christian character whose activity is in one of four holy cities.
details: Script fires it. It only runs for a character of the Christian religion whose activity location is in the county of Rome, Jerusalem, Constantinople or Alexandria. Each city has its own arrival event with equal weight, and there is also an event to meet the Mystic again. Vanilla keeps it in the pilgrimage files.

label: Claim throne failed
summary: Shows the failure event of a Claim Throne scheme, chosen from the way it was set up.
details: Script fires it. It uses the first event that is valid: a distant-relation failure or a mythical-founder failure. A third option (previous holder promise) is commented out in vanilla.

label: Claim throne ongoing
summary: Rolls a random event while a character is working on a Claim Throne scheme.
details: Script fires it. It needs the scheme to exist and is blocked while the character is travelling. Only a 5 percent chance applies to the whole roll, and 'nothing' has weight 50. The events are about ill omens for the liege, taking on responsibility, buying support, a friend promising support, and getting a knight on your side. It also includes a wrapper for general agent events.

label: Claim throne setup
summary: Sets up a character's Claim Throne run: marks them with a flag and starts the setup method.
details: Script fires it. It gives the character the flag is_executing_claim_throne for 365 days, then runs the first valid setup on_action, which in vanilla is only standard_claim_throne_method_setup.

label: Claim throne succeeded
summary: Shows the success event of a Claim Throne scheme and cleans up after it.
details: Script fires it. It uses the first valid event (distant relation or mythical founder), removes the is_executing_claim_throne flag and sets an achievement flag. Then it gives the scheme owner a small chance (2, scaled by their accolade progress) to make one of their knights eligible for the scoundrel accolade, if one qualifies. When that happens the owner's progress is reset to 0.

label: Clan events
summary: Rolls a random clan event for a ruler whose government is a clan.
details: Script fires it. It only runs for rulers whose government has the clan flag. There is a 50 percent chance of anything and 'nothing' has weight 500. Vanilla's comment says these events are kept apart so they do not compete with the regular yearly events.

label: Coerce contribution events
summary: Rolls a random event while a Coerce or Leverage Contribution scheme is running.
details: Script fires it. It needs the scheme to exist. There is a 20 percent chance of anything, and 'nothing' has weight 300. The three events are asking for coins at the market (Coerce only), the chaplain offering blessings (shared), and promising a hook on yourself (Leverage only), as vanilla's comments say.

label: Coerce tributary events
summary: Rolls a random event while a scheme to coerce a tributary is running.
details: Script fires it. It needs the scheme to exist. There is a 20 percent chance of anything, and 'nothing' has weight 300. The two events are a steward imposing bigger tariffs on the target and sending an intimidating party to threaten the target.

label: Commander harm events
summary: Rolls a rare event that can harm a character who is commanding an army.
details: Script fires it. It only runs while the character commands an army. 'Nothing' has weight 1000 against 20 for each of the eight events, so these are rare. The events are camp fever, marching illness, frostbite, heat-stroke, an assassination by aggrieved soldiers, starvation, and being caught while retreating or while chasing too far ahead.

label: Commission epic events
summary: Picks a random event while an epic is being commissioned.
details: Script fires it. It has no trigger and no 'nothing' entry. Vanilla's comments mark some events as fitting only certain court positions (steward, spymaster, court chaplain, marshal, chancellor), with two of them tied to a theocratic or lay clergy court chaplain. Two others make the character a friend or rival of a vassal.

label: Commit suicide
summary: Starts the events that let the character choose how they end their own life.
details: Vanilla's comment says it is triggered from the decision, and the decision uses it with on_action = commit_suicide. It lists two events, labelled 'Other' and 'Incapable' in vanilla's comments; the first is the general case and the second is for a character who is incapable.

label: Archery mysterious stranger
summary: Picks one of two outcomes for the mysterious stranger event of an archery contest.
details: An event of the contest fires it with trigger_event = { on_action = ... }. The outcomes are being arrested or disappearing, with equal weight. Vanilla keeps it in the dlc/ep2 tournament file.

label: Board game bout outcome
summary: Fires the outcome event of a board game bout in a contest.
details: Going by its name, it is the outcome step of a board game bout. It lists a single event, contest_events.0873, with no trigger of its own.

label: Board game bout pivotal moment
summary: Fires the pivotal moment event of a board game bout between two contestants.
details: It only runs if the game's tournament trigger for a versus event passes. It lists a single event, contest_events.0863.

label: Board game bout random event
summary: Rolls a random side event during a board game bout between two contestants.
details: It only runs if the tournament versus event trigger passes. Eight events have equal weight: psyching out, flipping the table, a big risk, trying to cheat, intimidating the opponent, Spanish rules, a suspicious person in the audience, and moving a piece while the audience is distracted.

label: Duel bout outcome
summary: Fires the outcome event of a duel bout in a contest.
details: Going by its name, it is the outcome step of a duel bout. It lists a single event, contest_events.0872, with no trigger of its own.

label: Duel bout pivotal moment
summary: Fires the pivotal moment event of a duel bout between two contestants.
details: It only runs if the tournament versus event trigger passes. It lists a single event, contest_events.0862.

label: Duel bout random event
summary: Rolls a random side event during a duel between two contestants.
details: It only runs if the tournament versus event trigger passes. Most events have weight 100. They cover a limping or crowd-pleasing opponent, an opponent who wants to quit or offers a bribe, dirty moves, a rare 'Out of Control' event, and others. Some are rarer (weight 50), and one is more likely (200).

label: Joust bout outcome
summary: Fires the outcome event of a joust bout in a contest.
details: Going by its name, it is the outcome step of a joust bout. It lists a single event, contest_events.0870, with no trigger of its own.

label: Joust bout pivotal moment
summary: Fires the pivotal moment event of a joust bout between two contestants.
details: It only runs if the tournament versus event trigger passes. It lists a single event, contest_events.0860.

label: Joust bout random event
summary: Rolls a random side event during a joust between two contestants.
details: It only runs if the tournament versus event trigger passes. Ten events have equal weight. They cover getting injured, the opponent being knocked off their horse, a huge lance, a challenge to fight on foot, a mercy pass, paying the opponent's groom, a heckling crowd, lending a lance, and a competitor who falls and is hurt.

label: Wrestling bout outcome
summary: Fires the outcome event of a wrestling bout in a contest.
details: Going by its name, it is the outcome step of a wrestling bout. It lists a single event, contest_events.0871, with no trigger of its own.

label: Wrestling bout pivotal moment
summary: Fires the pivotal moment event of a wrestling bout between two contestants.
details: It only runs if the tournament versus event trigger passes. It lists a single event, contest_events.0861.

label: Wrestling bout random event
summary: Rolls a random side event during a wrestling bout between two contestants.
details: It only runs if the tournament versus event trigger passes. There are many events of weight 100: dirt in the eyes, an oil check, distracting the referee, injuries, cheating accusations and more. Two rare events (weight 5) are death events for the character in the ring. One more (weight 50) is the 'Out of Control' event, which the melee list also uses.

label: Archery outcome
summary: Fires the turn outcome event of an archery contest.
details: It lists a single event, contest_events.0720, with no trigger of its own.

label: Archery pivotal moment
summary: Fires the pivotal skill check of an archery contest.
details: It only runs if the tournament contest event trigger passes. It lists a single event, contest_events.0710.

label: Archery random event
summary: Rolls a random side event during an archery contest.
details: It only runs if the tournament contest event trigger passes. 'Nothing' has weight 1. The events include a competitor demanding quiet, accidents at the butts, a bad day, arrow physics, boredom, livening up the contest, and a wayward arrow hitting another competitor. The mysterious stranger event is the most likely (250).

label: Horse race outcome
summary: Fires the outcome event of a horse race contest.
details: It lists a single event, contest_events.0530, with no trigger of its own.

label: Horse race pivotal moment
summary: Fires the pivotal skill check of a horse race contest.
details: It only runs if the tournament contest event trigger passes. It lists a single event, contest_events.0510.

label: Horse race random event
summary: Rolls a random side event during a horse race contest.
details: It only runs if the tournament contest event trigger passes. 'Nothing' has weight 1. The events include a tumble, collisions between jockeys, a horse bashed by another, a riot, a clever jockey, people swooning over a jockey, and a naked commoner running onto the track.

label: Melee AI events
summary: Gives a small chance of an accidental death event to a character taking part in a melee.
details: It only runs for a character who is in the guest subset named 'qualified' of the activity's current phase. There is a 33 percent chance of anything. Within that, the only event is an accidental death of an AI character (weight 5 against 100 for nothing). Vanilla's comment calls it AI maintenance and score events.

label: Melee outcome
summary: Fires the outcome event of a melee contest.
details: It lists a single event, contest_events.0620, with no trigger of its own.

label: Melee pivotal moment
summary: Fires the pivotal moment skill check of a melee contest.
details: It only runs if the tournament contest event trigger passes. It lists a single event, contest_events.0610.

label: Melee random event
summary: Rolls a random side event during a melee contest.
details: It only runs if the tournament contest event trigger passes. 'Nothing' has weight 1. The events include a brawl spilling into a town, an angry mayor, losing your weapon, ransoming a captive, meeting a famous knight, an ambush, saving a house member, and attacking a rival. One rare event (weight 5) is a death event.

label: Melee setup events
summary: Lists the melee events that should fire before the other melee events.
details: Vanilla's comment says it is for events that should fire before others. It lists three events, about murder intent: a planned murder, an unplanned one by the AI, and a third one without a comment (contest_events.1120).

label: Recital outcome
summary: Fires the turn outcome event of a recital contest.
details: It lists a single event, contest_events.0721, with no trigger of its own.

label: Recital pivotal moment
summary: Fires the pivotal skill check of a recital contest.
details: It only runs if the tournament contest event trigger passes. It lists a single event, contest_events.0711.
